notes.title: PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch
notes.notes:

notes.title: New courses, new championship and new car in v1.2.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Wazzap [b]arcade racers[/b]! [/h1]

We just realized that we haven't published any news updates since v1.0.5 and we are now on v1.2.2 😱

During the last months we've added new content, released Total Arcade Racing on Xbox and started on the PlayStation port. We have also started on our next game project, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1959330/Alienstein/]Alienstein[/url]. We are still planning to add more courses and possible cars in the future but releases will be less frequent. 

[h2]Latest updates[/h2]

[b]New course - Triple Cross[/b]
A course designed by one of our players where the course loops over the main path 3 times causing a lot of crashes and action. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/c7e3d847b57e5cb3ac7528c5e8b7fe586523470f.png[/img]

[b]New course - Tropical Asphalt[/b]
A course which is 50% asphalt and 50% dirt road, which is awesome for the new Buggy car. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/7ee9c43e47c9ad1761b3fe717a3b2ac3f47b0425.png[/img]

[b]New car - Buggy[/b]
A new car with fast acceleration and great performance both on-road and off-road. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/c7c6d9fa1e12bd89ba68accf2888d0ce6d8a73d8.png[/img]

[b]New championship - Crossy Cup[/b]
A new championship set in mostly urban courses. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/0e7678bdbf977b42cf0f26ab2df92acd7d20f996.png[/img]

notes.title: Racing out of Early Access
notes.notes:
Hey Arcade Racers!

After 9 months in Early Access we are ready to press the boost button and let Total Arcade Racing race out of Early Access.

We cannot thank the folks enough who played the game in Early Access and provided feedback, without you the game would be very different from what we released today. Thank you all!

So what happens now? Well hopefully the launch goes smoothly but usually there are few bugs that magically appear post launch. After that it really depends on you the gamers. If you like the game and play it we will keep adding content to the game, if you don't well lets be honest then there isn't much point in adding new content. 

We really hope that you enjoy the final product and it helps us a lot if you review the game. 

[b]Ladies and gentlemen start your engines and go get that #1 spot in Hall of Fame! [/b]

notes.title: Coming out of Early Access
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi-ya [b]arcade racers[/b]! [/h1]

We've set the release date of Total Arcade Racing to 7th of May 2021. It will be released on Steam and Nintendo Switch simultaneously. On Steam it won't be that dramatic since the game is already available as Early Access so we'll pretty much just flip the switch and it will be released. 

On Monday we'll be bringing the price up to the planned release tag which is 9.99$. We do this in order to have the ability to have a release discount of 30% on launch. So if you plan to buy the game then either do it before Monday or wait until the release to get the best deal. 

[h2]Latest updates[/h2]
Since the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1264730/view/4978136625135603315]last news post [/url] we've released 10 updates. Here are some of the highlights in the updates.

[b]Support for keyboard mapping[/b]
The most frequent request we've had is the ability to remap the keyboard. Implementing remapping of  keyboards isn't as easy as it sounds but we think that we did a pretty good job in our implementation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/aeba65620449985f61ce6f6c95f3893be4447148.gif[/img]

[b]New course - Jungle Rally[/b]
We set out to create a new biome and after playing around with various concepts we decided to create a jungle style course. On this course you'll drive on a dirt road where the offroad cars have an edge compared with the other cars that will slip around a lot more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/6c0c6826a5f251dcd8ed00e6acc4e535db768453.png[/img]

[b]New course - Jungle Leap[/b]
Jumps are always fun in levels but they are pretty hard to get properly incorporated into levels. But on the jungle course they feel just right. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/567aa6c153065e357d22ac3a72bf66ca47269412.png[/img]

[b]New course - Lost in Suburbia[/b]
The suburbia style level was a great addon and we decided to create another course with a similar concept but with a lot more track. This is probably the longest track we've done so far which covers most of the screen :) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/b5042fad509bcc2c18ea056851e0dcf7de87cfe6.png[/img]

[b]Endless love[/b]
Endless mode has been somewhat lacking when it comes to variation and also how traffic worked. So either it was time to toss this mode all together or get it updated. We decided to keep the mode and put in a lot of effort to make it better. There is still room to improve it with more variation and tuning but we're pretty happy with the result now. 

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
[b]Keep the feedback coming[/b] either through the Steam forums or drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/AyYtKXT]Discord Server [/url] to have a chat with us and the community. 

[h2]Detailed change log[/h2]

[b]v0.8.8[/b]
* Improved: Increased variation of endless blocks spawned.
* Improved: Added new section to endless mode.
* Improved: More variation in traffic level in Endless Mode

[b]v0.8.4[/b]

notes.title: Development news and new content
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings [b]arcade racers[/b]! [/h1]

A lot of the required features are now implemented in Total Arcade Racing which has given us the chance to focus on adding more content. Since the last news update we've added 3 new courses, 1 car and 1 new game mode. Mac support has become a more frequent request and since v0.7.3 you can enjoy Mac support through Steam. Thank you all for the feedback and suggestions for Total Arcade Racing, keep it coming and we'll try our best to deliver on it. 

[h2]Latest updates[/h2]
Since the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1264730/view/2936876825429438292]last news post [/url] we've released 9 updates. Here are some of the highlights in the updates.

[b]New course - Suburbia[/b]
Inspired by the car mats you had as a kid we created a course with a suburb style. Here is a short clip of how it was made. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/95085c526fb065de4263b63b51c04404ab82bf97.gif[/img]

[b]New course - Mishap Station[/b]
Ever since we added the train crossing in Endless mode, we wanted to create a level with a train in it. After a lot of experimenting,  we created Mishap Station where you can optionally drive on the train track but most of the time it's a really bad idea.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/dfde4787fde076dce6f537e03f9f7926b1cecb36.png[/img]

[b]New course - Bridgeton[/b]
A fast-paced course with a lot of twists and bends. Fits the new F1 inspired car perfectly. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/670ce5d3ddf68b48e683a8e90240227bb5bc8cfc.png[/img]

[b]New car[/b]
A new F1 inspired car has been added with very little drift and massive acceleration. This is a perfect choice on narrow courses with a lot of turns and bends. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/a233bb918165d207a49f14a24fdcbdafd33a4c1e.png[/img]

[b]Delivery game mode[/b]
Inspired by capture the flag style gameplay you need to pickup a box and bring it to the delivery zone as fast as possible. Other players can steal your box by hitting it! Currently this is a multiplayer only game mode but maybe we should add single player and a Hall of fame leaderboard to this mode also? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/715295044cd1058492ba4dbd8eb265a00b217056.gif[/img]

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
[b]Keep the feedback coming[/b] either through the Steam forums or drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/AyYtKXT]Discord Server [/url] to have a chat with us and the community.

notes.title: Championship mode is finally here
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy 2021 [b]arcade racers[/b]! [/h1]

We hope you all had a nice start to 2021. At Pretty Fly Games we've had a flying start and have been pushing out lots of updates for Total Arcade Racing. One of the core features that we planned a long time ago is Championship mode, where you would race across a few courses with either your friends or with AI, and now it's finally here!   

[h2]Latest updates[/h2]
Since the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1264730/partnerevents/edit/2899718957492482888]last news post [/url] we've released 11 updates. Here are some of the highlights in the updates.

[b]Nitro Boosters[/b]
The booster areas in the game were a fun feature but it felt quite limiting in a way. So, we replaced them with a nitro booster that charges as you drive. When you are ready just hit that X button, just make sure it's a good spot. Nitro boosters also works in other game modes where it can give you a nice boost and lets you make better shots in Hockey or get out of tricky situations in Survival. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/bd928cef4bfca0c4695b3fce6add3f4b77f02956.gif[/img]

[b]Championship mode[/b]
Race against your friends or just he AI and beat the other drivers. You need to be on your toes during all course to win. If you reach that #1 in total standings, then you'll unlock next course and the AI difficulity increases with each championship. Championship mode comes with its own Hall of fame. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/a77ec56a1914f29a595f59305b1f4ad649203470.png[/img]

[b]Improved AI[/b]
To really give a challenge in championship mode we had to improve the AI drivers a lot. In custom race mode you can set the AI difficulty level but in championship mode it gets harder in PRO races. 

[b]Fast forward[/b]
In championship mode you need to wait for 20 seconds when you finish to give those other slower drivers a chance to reach the standing leaderboard. If you are racing on your own it quickly becomes a bit boring. Now you can fast forward by holding down Y once you've completed the race.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/23f0092f161a05f428dd9cc464211d8ebb511a2d.gif[/img]

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
[b]Keep the feedback coming[/b] either through the Steam forums or drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/AyYtKXT]Discord Server [/url] to have a chat with us and the community. 

[h2]Detailed change log[/h2]

[b]v0.6.9[/b]
* New feature: While waiting for the AI to finish a championship race you can now fast forward by pressing Y on your controller.

* Improved: Added background to locked championship name to increase readability.
* Improved: Slightly improved jump graphics.
* Improved: Set a max time for how long the ai will chase the player. After a while they'll give up.

* Fixed bug: First time you come into a scene and hit pause the mouse cursor doesn't show on PC.
* Fixed bug: Changes to Hall of fame broke Endless and Survivor mode.
* Fixed bug: In Endless mode AI cars was driving at max speed all the time.

[b]v0.6.8[/b]

* Improved: Added more flags to country selection. 
* Fixed bug: If you place #1 on a leaderboard but you're not using Steam then the leaderboard will be empty.

[b]v0.6.7[/b]

* Improved: Player has the same limitation as AI in championships. PRO cups allow all cars, AM cups do not.

* Fixed bug: On car unlock dialog, selecting no on Gamepad (Press B) still selects the new car.
* Fixed bug: When AI falls into the water they change color to the same color as the player.

[b]v0.6.6[/b]

[b]v0.6.5[/b]

* New Feature: ability to set AI skill level 10-100% i custom race.

notes.title: Change of studio name, new course, new game mode and much more
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi [b]arcade racers[/b]! [/h1]

Sorry... its been slightly over 1 month since our last news update and that's a bit too long in our opinion. However, we've been super busy with the game and have added a lot of content (new course, new game mode and a long list of improvements). But first of all, we've changed studio name, say hello to... 

[h2]Pretty Fly Games[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/ceecb249cdd74faabd0156aa1017b0e6dfdf8eca.jpg[/img]

Long story short, our old studio name CasualGames.nu, was rather limiting and well plain old. So we wanted something that represents the games we work now, which are pretty fly :)
 
[h2]Latest updates[/h2]
Since the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1264730/view/2932367519386256531]last news post [/url] we've released 8 updates. Here are some of the highlights in the updates.

[b]New Course - Concrete Island[/b]
To continue the Harbor course we've added a similar course but with a twist. There are fire posts and if you hit them, they'll start spraying water which might push you into the water. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/8171f3c440e878abce466a442baec9a9d46c91de.png[/img]

[b]Improved menu graphics[/b]
We've replaced the menu with a new fresh version where the AI zips around random courses. The logo for Total Arcade Racing also received a face lift. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/875595bdd05711f443bc09c051eb03b666584ba3.png[/img]

[b]New game mode - Elimination[/b]
In Elimination the rules are simple, each lap the player who is last will be eliminated. Don't be last. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/c96f71458bbf5c3e6ab3f99057e62c9fb26730f0.gif[/img]

[h2]Price increase[/h2]
When we launched the Early Access version, we said that the price would periodically increase with new releases. We're now at version 0.6.0 and we've added a bunch of stuff since the last price increase in v0.4.6. Therefor  the price will be increased to 6.99$ on Friday the 11th of December. If you haven't already grabbed a copy at 5.99$ then make sure that you do it now. 

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
[b]Keep the feedback coming[/b] either through the Steam forums or drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/AyYtKXT]Discord Server [/url] to have a chat with us and the community.

notes.title: New course, Achievements, new game mode and bunch of other new stuff
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello [b]arcade racers[/b]! [/h1]

The last few weeks have been amazing, and we've been throwing out updates faster than ever. Most additions have been suggestions from the community which makes us super happy. 

[h2]Latest updates[/h2]
Since the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1264730/view/2899714517686852211]last news post [/url] we've released 6 updates. Here are some of the highlights in the updates.

[b]Harbor course[/b]
To test your skills as a Pro Arcade Racer we've added a new course where you race along the docks in a harbor. There is a pretty large risk that you'll fall into the water but don't worry, we've added a rescue feature that will pull your car out of the water again.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/c03733177d37da95b5fa7a3fc2e46137405c4408.png[/img]

[b]Achievements[/b]
Achievements is a feature that we said would be delivered during the Early Access and now it's been added to the game. We'd like more feedback in this area to answer questions like: how many achievements would you like, how hard should they be to unlock? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/c8989ed3e75e5cc549c9d43f814119e4a6709536.png[/img]

[b]Car Hockey[/b]
A new wacky local multiplayer mode, Car Hockey, has been added with support for 8 players. In Car Hockey you compete in two Teams, Red vs Blue, and it's all about getting the puck into the goal using any means possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/50727e933f10516989d648a23060911e364e9180.png[/img]

[b]Keep the feedback coming[/b] either through the Steam forums or drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/AyYtKXT]Discord Server [/url] to have a chat with us and the community. 

[h2]Detailed change log[/h2]
[b]v0.5.2[/b]
* New Course: Harbor
* New feature: Ability to land in water and respawn again.
* Fixed bug: Cars collided with cars even if they were flying.
* Fixed bug: Turbo start was not working with new count down system.
* Fixed bug: Lap timer was not working properly with new count down system.

[b]v0.5.1[/b]
* New Feature: Added new achievement, Take a dip.
* Improved: Better count down before a race starts.
* Fixed Bug: The start field is too narrow on the bridge level causing texts to overlap.

[b]v0.5.0[/b]
* New feature: Added option to disable ghost car replays in settings.
* Improved: Pace cars will start even if a race has been started once the download of the pace car data is completed. However there is a max limit of 10 seconds but that should provide sufficient time even for very bad internet connections.
* Improved: Added more flags.
* Improved: Improved performance in Endless mode.
* Improved: Added support for D-pad input on gamepads.
* Improved: Cars is now ordered in how many stars they require to unlock in the UI.
* Improved: Changed direction that cars or courses moves when you select them. Feedback was that it was moving in the wrong direction in regards to the input.
* Fixed Bug: White flag was shown when a user's country was missing, showing EU flag instead now.
* Fixed bug: In endless mode you could at times drive through AI cars.
* Fixed bug: When you start the game for the first time the pre-selected car was locked.
* Fixed bug: The help text for Next action was missing in course select if you didn't have a gamepad plugged in.
* Fixed bug: It was impossible to stop a race from starting once the AI had started to select cars in the main menu.
* Fixed bug: It was not possible to unlock stars in local multiplayer when racing with AI.

[b]v0.4.9[/b]
* New Feature: Added new achievement, Driver license.
* New Feature: Added new achievement, Best of the best.

[b]v0.4.8[/b]
* New Feature: Added support for Steam Achievements.
* Fixed bug: Steam service was not started properly at times.

[b]v0.4.7[/b]
* New Feature: Car Hockey mode.
* Improved: Reduced audio of scraping SFX.
* Improved: Reduced Audio of car hit SFX.
* Fixed bug: It was not possible to drive on the grass in Demolition Derby.

notes.title: New music tracks and lots of improvements in latest updates
notes.notes:
[h1]Howdy [b]arcade racers[/b]! [/h1]

First of all, a big thanks to all of you who are playing Total Arcade Racing. An even bigger thanks goes out to the folks who have provided feedback, it's super important for us and the development of the game. 

[h2]Price increase[/h2]
When we launched the Early Access version, we said that the price would periodically increase with new releases. We're not at version 0.4.6 and we've added a bunch of stuff since the initial launch. Therefor  the price will be increased to 5.99$ on Monday the 19th of October. If you haven't already grabbed a copy at 4.99$ then make sure that you do it now. 

[h2]Latest updates[/h2]
Since the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1264730/view/2890704783120336752]last news post [/url] we've released 4 updates. Here are some of the highlights in the updates.

[b]Mooaaare music tracks[/b]
Although the original single music track for Total Arcade Racing was very catchy, it got pretty annoying after you've heard it 20 times in a row. So, we've added a bunch of new tracks making it a total of 6 tracks! 

[b]Train crossing in Endless mode[/b]
Endless mode is a mode which needs a lot more work to become truly fun and challenging. A big step in this direction is the addition of a train crossing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/f1afcbfc0582e58de7c5a9be5267cb13afaf7e0a.gif[/img]

[b]Time required for 3 stars[/b]
Several people have asked us what times is required to get 3 stars on various courses. We don't mind you asking but to be fair to everyone else we've added it to the UI. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/661506e8f0428b99552024075784869eb762f3e6.png[/img]

[b]Improved graphics and variation[/b]
We've added more details to each course to make it more interesting. This was also implemented in Endless mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/b23b0a91473ef3516cab5ccf7c8ef87b2259c4ae.png[/img]

[b]Keep the feedback coming[/b] either through the Steam forums or drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/AyYtKXT]Discord Server [/url] to have a chat with us and the community.

* Improved: In endless mode changed UI to a pattern instead when you pass another players top distance.
* Improved: AI enhanced, cars will no longer try to reverse when stuck unless something is blocking them.

notes.title: Improved Hall of fame and more option in v0.4.2 update
notes.notes:
[h1]Howdy [b]arcade racers[/b]! [/h1]

First of all if you wish to get these updates via email, then [url=http://casualgames.us7.list-manage2.com/subscribe?u=9473166ce99e745e65a965b69&id=b0d8be6720]subscribe to our newsletter[/url].

Its been a month since we released Total Arcade Racing on Steam Early Access. 

Our goal with the Early Access release was to get feedback from actual players who like arcade racing games, and boy did you guys deliver! We've gotten a lot of suggestions how to make the game better and a few bug reports, actually a lot fewer than we expected. 

The top request feature was the ability to be able to run Total Arcade Racing in window mode. In the v0.4.2 release we added support for this and the ability to change the resolution which the game runs at. 
While working on this we realized that a number of things was not working that good unless you played the game in wide screen mode (16:9) so we worked hard to improve the overall experience regardless of the aspect ratio you use. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/37fd02e2673a24a359c8ec0b042df3a88b921e2a.png[/img]

The 2nd most frequent requested feature was the ability to view the Hall of fame from the main menu to check that you still have that awesome #1 position. This was added with the v0.4.1 release with a bunch of additional improvements related to Hall of fame. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/55cc81e6c088f3d82963617e5a13c7a6d489bdad.png[/img]

The progress when it comes to new content and game modes have been slower than planned. We hope to pick up the pace and deliver faster in the future.

[b]Keep the feedback coming[/b] either through the Steam forums or drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/AyYtKXT]Discord Server [/url] to have a chat with us and the community. 

[h2]Detailed change log[/h2]
[b]v0.4.2[/b]
* New feature: Added settings option to toggle between full screen and windowed mode.
* New Feature: Added setting to change resolution.
* Improved: Country selection improved.
* Improved: UI scales better with different resolutions and aspect ratios.

* Fixed Bug: When running a screen resolution other than 16:9 then parts of the main menu background was sometimes visible while playing. 

[b]v0.4.1[/b]
* New feature: Added leaderboard on main menu so you can browse through the different hall of fames. 

* Improved: Added option to race with bots in single player mode.
* Improved: Made it a little bit easier to get stars.
* Improved: Hall of fame added upload/download re-try feature.
* Improved: Hall of fame scrolling improved.

* Fixed Bug: Endless mode had a weird issue with overlay drawing when starting the level.

notes.title: Total Arcade Racing out on Steam Early Access
notes.notes:
Great news! Total Arcade Racing is out on Steam Early Access. It’s a big milestone in the development and we’re excited to work closer together with the community in the development of this game.

During the Early Access stage of development we will add more courses, cars, achievements and probably new game modes. We are excited to get your feedback and suggestions which will have a big impact on the development of the game. We are certain that you have ideas that we have not even though of. The price will increase over time as we add more content so if you like this game we recommend that you buy it early.

What happened to the demo version? As we’ve entered into Early Access we decided to scrapped the demo as it was already outdated and keeping two versions of the game updated takes a lot of effort which slows down the development. Once the game is completed and fully release we might do a demo version again, we’ll see.

The main discussion forum is our [url=https://discord.gg/AyYtKXT]Discord Server[/url] but we’ll also use Steam Forums.

notes.title: New game mode added: Survivor
notes.notes:
The development of Total Arcade Racing is progressing according to plans. 

A new game mode, Survivor, has just been completed. In survivor you can either play alone or with up to 8 friends locally. The goal is to avoid waves of incoming cars with explosives, if they hit any other car they will explode. The blast from the explosion will also affect other cars. If you play alone you'll be able to compete with others around the globe with the hall of fame system. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37273838/505a72f8ad90083014bd485c5e501e38e90ccdcc.gif[/img]

As always feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/AyYtKXT]Discord Server[/url] to learn more about the development of the game, come with suggestions or just hang out.
